source.title: Film Connection Locations: Film School Near You
source.description: Find Film Connection film school locations across the US. Learn film production hands on from industry mentors, in person or online, in your city.
source.content:
“I understand pre-sales and licensing now — and how to negotiate them.”
We have filmmaking professionals in cities throughout the U.S. Our professional directors, editors, cinematographers, screenwriters and producers will train you inside their film companies as an extern, teaching you many of the crucial technical skills you need to work in film. At the same time, you’ll also be paired with a professional director, producer or screenwriter who will help you develop your best idea for a great movie. You will then fly to L.A. or New York and pitch your idea to a studio, executive, or film producer who can get your movie made. They don’t call us revolutionary for nothing.
Film Production Programs and Courses for a new age. Learn, produce and share with the world in locations across the world.
Select any region from across the United States!
Some of our graduates have gone on to become film directors, script writers, and production company owners. Others are creating and producing their own films across genres like documentary, drama, comedy, action, and animation
